papers.title: Moderate Li–N Coordination Between Dibromopyrazine and Polysulfides Enables High‐Rate Lithium–Sulfur Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Lithium–sulfur (Li–S) batteries are promising candidates for high‐energy storage, yet their practical application is limited by poor rate capability. To date, the conversion of lithium polysulfides (LiPSs) remains a major challenge due to the high energy barrier of the liquid–solid conversion from Li 2 S 4 to Li 2 S. Herein, to overcome this barrier, dibromopyrazine (DBP) was identified through screening as an effective electrolyte additive owing to its unique Br─C═N functionality, which weakens Li–S bonding via moderate Li–N coordination through the electron‐withdrawing effect of Br, thereby enabling effective LiPSs anchoring without impeding conversion. In the electrolyte containing 0.04 M DBP, the interaction favors Li 2 S 4 formation at 2.3 V and promotes three‐dimensional (3D) Li 2 S deposition. Consequently, the Li–S coin cells deliver a high capacity of 785 mAh g −1 at the high rate of 6 C and a low capacity decay rate of 0.09% per cycle over 1000 cycles at 1 C. A 2 Ah pouch cell also demonstrates stable cycling over 100 cycles at 0.5 C. This work highlights a coordination‐modulated moderate‐interaction strategy for accelerating LiPSs conversion in Li–S batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 디브로모피라진(DBP)의 Br-C=N 구조가 전자 끌어당김 효과를 통해 Li-N 배위를 적절히 약화시켜 폴리설파이드 전환을 촉진, 6C에서 785 mAh/g의 고율 용량과 1000사이클 0.09%/사이클의 낮은 용량감쇄율을 갖는 리튬-황전지를 구현했다.

papers.title: Interphase-controlled mechanical confinement of Na clustering for high-rate sodium storage
papers.abstract_en: Chemical stitching tailors the closed-pore mouth of hard carbon, forming a high-modulus, inorganic-rich intrapore solid electrolyte interphase that mechanically confines Na-cluster growth and enables fast sodium storage.
papers.summary_ko: 화학적 스티칭으로 경질탄소의 폐쇄기공 입구를 조절, 고강성 무기물이 풍부한 기공 내 SEI를 형성해 소듐 클러스터 성장을 기계적으로 제한함으로써 고속 소듐 저장을 구현했다.

papers.title: In Situ Formed Co(OH)F Enabling Electronic and Atomic‐Level Structure Optimization in Medium‐Entropy Fluoride Cathodes for Zinc Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Cobalt‐based cathodes have attracted considerable attention in aqueous zinc batteries, however, their application remains impeded by intrinsic trade‐off between high electrochemical activity and long‐term cycling stability. Herein, an entropy‐regulated fluoride cathode is proposed to overcome the limitations via co‐engineering electronic and atomic structures. Specifically, x‐ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS), x‐ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), and first‐principle calculations collectively demonstrate that Co(OH)F is formed in situ within the fluoride matrix during electrochemical cycling and induces electron reconstruction. Concurrently, the generated Co(OH)F shortens Co─F bond length within the entropy‐regulated fluoride, reinforcing atomic‐level structural integrity and enabling excellent cycling performance. Moreover, a hollow architecture is integrated to homogenize flux and electric field distributions, ensuring sufficient accessibility of active sites while mitigating interfacial degradation. Consequently, the assembled zinc battery exhibits a high specific capacity of 252.3 mAh·g −1 and superior cycling stability (92.4% capacity retention after 25 000 cycles at 10 A·g −1 and 90.8% capacity retention after 50 000 cycles at 20 A·g −1 ). This work demonstrates a synergistic approach that simultaneously achieves high redox activity and structural robustness in cobalt‐based cathodes for zinc batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 전기화학 사이클링 중 생성된 Co(OH)F가 엔트로피 조절 플루오라이드 양극 내 전자 재구성과 Co-F 결합 단축을 유도, 중간엔트로피 플루오라이드 아연전지에서 252.3 mAh/g 용량과 5만 사이클에서도 90.8% 용량유지율을 달성했다.

papers.title: Disordered nanodomains stabilize near-degeneracy in complex layered oxides
papers.abstract_en: Reversible lithium intercalation in layered transition metal oxides is often accompanied by irreversible phase transformation, setting fundamental limits on the capacity and longevity achievable in lithium-ion batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 복잡한 층상 산화물에서 비정질 나노도메인이 준축퇴 상태를 안정화하여, 리튬 인터칼레이션에 따른 비가역적 상전이를 억제하는 메커니즘을 규명했다.

papers.title: Cathode Depolarization Enables 1300‐Cycle Ah‐Level Anode‐Free Sodium Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Nonuniform sodium deposition limits the cyclability of anode‐free sodium batteries (AFSBs), and current research mainly focuses on anode‐targeted strategies. However, the influence of the cathode kinetics on sodium deposition behavior has been overlooked. Here, we firstly reveal the critical role of cathode polarization on sodium deposition uniformity via electric field coupling. Accordingly, cathode‐specific charging (CSC) protocols are established for AFSBs to depolarize the cathode, where the charging current is dynamically regulated based on the state of charge (SOC)‐dependent direct current inner resistance (DCIR). As expected, the CSC protocols effectively depolarize the cathodes and thus homogenize sodium deposition on the anode. Impressively, a 1.6 Ah Al/C||NFPP pouch cell reaches a record‐high cyclability of 1370 cycles at 2 C, and a 3.6 Ah pouch cell reaches a high energy density of 180 Wh kg − 1 with stable cycling for 890 cycles at 0.5 C. More importantly, the cathode depolarization strategy shows application universality for diverse anode‐free full cells based on Na 4 Fe 3 (PO 4 ) 2 (NFPP), Na 3 V 2 (PO 4 ) 3 (NVP), and NaNi 1/3 Fe 1/3 Mn 1/3 O 2 (NFM) cathodes. This work opens an avenue for fabricating durable practical AFSBs.
papers.summary_ko: 비균일한 소듐 증착이 음극-프리 소듐전지의 수명을 제한하는 원인이 음극이 아닌 양극 분극에 있음을 규명, SOC 기반 동적 충전전류 조절(CSC) 프로토콜로 양극 분극을 해소해 1.6Ah Al/C||NFPP 파우치셀에서 1370사이클의 기록적 수명을 달성했다.

papers.title: Physically Grounded Descriptors for Machine-Learning-Guided Diluent Design in Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Localized high-concentration electrolytes require diluents that avoid direct Li+ coordination and preserve Li+-anion aggregates while remaining miscible with the primary solvent. Rational discovery has remained difficult because these competing requirements arise from chemically distinct interactions that have lacked computable molecular design coordinates. Fluorination has therefore been widely used to suppress electron donation, but the environmental persistence and synthetic burden of fluorinated molecules motivate alternative strategies for controlling diluent functionality. Here, we resolve the key interaction requirements of diluents using two complementary descriptors: BF3 affinity for specific electron-pair donation and the molecular polarity index (MPI) for distributed nonspecific electrostatic interactions. These descriptors reproduce established donor-number and Kamlet–Taft π* trends and, more importantly, distinguish noncoordinating yet miscible diluents from solvating and immiscible solvents. Coupling this interaction-based framework with uncertainty-aware machine learning enabled screening of 1.32 million nonfluorinated molecules and identified 368 candidates while recovering false negatives and excluding false positives near the decision boundaries. Newly selected aromatic hydrocarbons, including 1,2,4-trimethylbenzene and 2-ethyltoluene, sustained stable cycling in Li-metal full cells for more than 200 cycles, whereas a descriptor-excluded analogue underwent rapid capacity decay. These results establish specific coordination and distributed electrostatics as predictive design coordinates for diluent discovery.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬 금속 전지용 국부 고농도 전해질에서 Li+와 직접 배위하지 않으면서도 주용매와 혼화성을 유지하는 희석제를 설계하기 위해 BF3 친화도와 분자극성지수(MPI)라는 두 가지 물리 기반 디스크립터를 제안했다. 이를 불소를 포함하지 않는 132만 개 분자에 대한 불확실성 인식 머신러닝 스크리닝에 적용하여 368개의 유망 희석제 후보를 도출했다. 새로 선별된 방향족 탄화수소(1,2,4-트리메틸벤젠, 2-에틸톨루엔 등)는 리튬 금속 완전셀에서 200사이클 이상 안정적으로 구동된 반면, 디스크립터 기준에서 배제된 유사 분자는 급격한 용량 저하를 보였다.

papers.title: Bridging Ionic Field Strength Disparity in O3-Type Layered Oxides for High-Voltage Sodium-Ion Batteries
papers.venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract_en: Abstract O3-type layered oxides represent an attractive class of sodium-ion battery cathodes, combining high theoretical specific capacity and high pristine Na content. However, their deeply desodiated frameworks at high voltages (≥4.0 V) are prone to redox-coupled distortion of TMO6 octahedra within the transition metal (TM) slabs, leading to severe structural degradation. Here, we originally define an ionic field strength disparity coefficient (η), which enables quantitative evaluation of the local chemical-field heterogeneity. The η is derived from the ratio between the standard deviation and the average value of ionic field strength (Φ) of all TM ions, defined as Φ= Z/r2, where Z and r correspond to the ionic charge and ionic radius, respectively. Introducing compensatory cations with an intermediate Φ value between two cations featuring largely disparate Φ values effectively reconciles local chemical-field discrepancy and lowers the η parameter upon charge–discharge processes. Moreover, synchrotron X-ray absorption spectroscopy, strain mapping analyses, and first-principles calculations reveal that the low-η sample demonstrates the reduced lattice strain and enhanced structural reversibility. Consistently, electrochemical evaluation shows that it retains more than 80% of its capacity after 500 cycles at 10C, markedly outperforming the unmodified counterpart with only 22% retention. This work establishes the η as a quantitative descriptor for inactive dopant selection and provides a general strategy for developing highly stable layered oxide cathodes.
papers.summary_ko: O3형 층상 소듐 이온 전지 양극재가 고전압(4.0V 이상)에서 TMO6 팔면체의 산화환원 연계 왜곡으로 구조가 열화되는 문제를 해결하기 위해, 전이금속 이온들의 이온장세기(Φ) 분산 정도를 정량화하는 이온장세기 불균일 계수(η)를 새롭게 정의했다. Φ 값이 중간인 보상 양이온을 도입해 η를 낮추면 충방전 중 국소 화학장 불균일과 격자 변형이 줄어듦을 방사광 X선 흡수분광법, 변형률 매핑, 제일원리 계산으로 확인했다. 그 결과 저η 샘플은 10C, 500사이클 후 80% 이상의 용량 유지율을 보여 미개질 샘플(22%)보다 현저히 우수했다.

papers.title: Alkali hydrides catalyze hydrogenolysis of polystyrene to alkylbenzenes under mild conditions
papers.abstract_en: This study introduces a highly efficient, transition-metal-free method for upcycling polystyrene (PS) waste using alkali metal hydrides, specifically KH, as a catalyst. Operating under mild conditions (130 °C, 1 bar H₂, 3 hours), KH achieves an impressive 93.2% yield of gaseous products and alkylbenzenes, with 95.8% selectivity toward alkylbenzenes. The production rate of 313.3 mmolcarbon/gKH/h is approximately 2.6 times higher than noble-metal catalysts operating at much higher temperatures (280 °C). This versatile approach is effective on diverse real-life PS waste. Mechanistically, depolymerization is driven by a synergy between direct hydride-induced Hδ+(C) abstraction and K+···π interactions with adjacent phenyl rings. This interaction elongates the C(sp³)–C(sp³) bonds, facilitating targeted cleavage into alkylbenzenes. Ultimately, this work establishes hydride catalysis as an energy-efficient platform for plastic depolymerization, providing crucial insights for designing mild-condition catalysts to address the global plastic waste crisis. Catalytic hydrogenolysis has been explored for polystyrene degradation, but its dependence on transition-metal catalysts and harsh conditions reduces its practicality. Here, the authors report the selective hydrogenolysis of polystyrene into alkylbenzenes under mild conditions (low temperature and hydrogen pressure) using alkali metal hydrides.
papers.summary_ko: 폴리스티렌 폐기물을 알칼리 금속 수소화물(KH)을 촉매로 사용해 전이금속 없이 130°C, 1기압 수소 조건에서 알킬벤젠으로 수소분해하는 방법을 제시했다. KH는 기체 및 알킬벤젠 생성물에 대해 93.2% 수율과 95.8%의 알킬벤젠 선택성을 달성했으며, 생산 속도는 더 가혹한 조건에서 작동하는 귀금속 촉매보다 약 2.6배 높았다. 메커니즘적으로는 하이드라이드에 의한 수소 인발과 K+-π 상호작용의 시너지가 C(sp3)-C(sp3) 결합을 늘려 선택적 절단을 유도하는 것으로 나타났다.
